notes: Strip e: x 7040-8600 plus overlap (x 6740-8900). Queen City Avenue runs along the top (north line partly the plate edge, tabs for Pinetree, Lawnway, Beekman). Westwood Avenue merges into Harrison Avenue at a narrow gore (lot 53, tip ~(6900,857)); Harrison's NW branch carries the streetcar tracks. Harrison runs ESE from Beekman, bends SSE at ~(8500,1460), curves south and continues as State Avenue (name change taken at the junction where the upper Harrison road branches east, (8930,2078), 30 px outside the overlap). Unnamed (?): the 60 ft ENE street printed STREET from the Hiawatha junction to Harrison (Meader and Ernst end on it; a yellow frame building strip in lot 75 lies along its north side; its south line jogs north at Ernst); the Grotenkemper streets printed STREET: E-W at y~2122 and y~3225 (40 ft), N-S at x~6955 and x~7631 (50 ft; the east one turns SSW at y~3277 and dead-ends at the boundary at y~3705). Prospect Street (printed PROSPECT) runs SSE from Hiawatha, S, then SSW and is printed JEAN'S STREET / JEAN south of the subdivision line; recorded as Jean Street from y~3700. Shelby meets Lehman Road ~220 px WSW of Jean (not one cross point on this scan). Not streets: railroads (single diagonal through Ernst's Sub, the yards east), boundary bands, the gray vertical band at x~7180 south of Lick Run Alley, subdivision lettering (GROTENKEMPER, CHAS. LEHMAN'S SUBDIV'N, JEAN'S SUBDIV'N, ERNST'S SUB, EDWARD DODSON'S EST., J. A. JAMES). Detroit name taken from 22-31R (not printed on this stub).
